rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A hou2 hoi1 sam1
rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to say that something cheers someone up or makes them happy.

example.english: That joke you told can exhilarate me.
example.traditional: 聽完你講嗰個笑話，搞到我好開心。
example.jyutping: teng1 jyun4 nei5 gong2 go2 go3 siu3 waa2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A hou2 hing1 fan5
rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on thrilling or exciting someone rather than simply making them happy.

example.english: Riding the roller coaster can exhilarate me.
example.traditional: 坐過山車搞到我好興奮。
example.jyutping: zo6 gwo3 saan1 ce1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 hing1 fan5
